payload.title: Canonical IR types and contract version stamp
payload.description:
Implement the canonical IR types and the contract-version stamp that every observation carries.

Fields per the behaviour spec: observation identity; concept leaf plus taxonomy ancestry; component type, subtype, instance/vendor; evidence locations (plural — see B10); source name; display name. Version is stamped on load so a baseline can record which contract produced it.

Replaces the current overloaded `type:name` string and the `EvalCase`/`LayerFinding` pair in `tests/eval/types.ts` as the scoring currency.
